reason: The duck socks are funny and €30 is nothing to me, but I buy on impulse, and that means I want it now. Paying €4.99 to reserve something that might never hit 100 reservations, with no delivery date, kills the buzz, so I'd scroll on and probably forget about it.
objection: Why pay €4.99 just to reserve something with no date? I could be waiting months, or it might never get made, while Zalando gets me stuff in two days.
would_change_my_mind: A real ship date, or buying it outright with normal delivery like any other shop, so I can check out in one tap and actually get it.
